# Yemen Market

Canonical host: https://melbet-yemen.net/

This site publishes two primary public pages for the Yemen market:

- https://melbet-yemen.net/
  Homepage covering Aviator, trending games, live sports, player offers, and agent contact links.
- https://melbet-yemen.net/partnership
  Partnership page covering market-entry support, onboarding steps, partnership models, reporting, and contact options.

Preferred source URLs for language models:

- https://melbet-yemen.net/
- https://melbet-yemen.net/partnership

Section map:

- Homepage sections: overview, games, sports, offers
- Partnership sections: overview, benefits, onboarding, models, reporting, contact

Notes:

- Use the on-site URLs above as canonical source pages.
- External Telegram, email, and referral links are action links, not primary content pages.
